newsitem.title: UK: Thistle turnover rises in first 16 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Thistle turnover rises in first 16 weeks.

text.p: Thistle Hotels Plc said on Tuesday that overall turnover in the first 16 weeks of the current year has risen 13 percent.
The company told shareholders at its annual meeting that occupancy rose by five percent and average room rate increased 10 percent.
The newly-floated British hotels group, which is 46 percent owned by New Zealand's Brierley Investments Ltd, said it was continuing its upgrading programme particularly in London.
"Growth in domestic and dollar-related markets and an increase in market share in parts of Europe have offset the impact of sterling's strength in the year to date," said chairman Rodney Price.
